info.title: Prospecter API
info.description:
Exposes the use cases of `prospecter/core`.

Authentication: the members sign in with the Cognito user pool of `GET /api/user-pool`
(SRP, client of the SPA), then send `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` on every call.

Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`);
validation errors list the invalid fields in `violations`.
